name: Live Wallpaper
author: CristoSolar
description: Animated wallpapers for Omarchy, one video per theme. Pick the theme image or a video from the bar, using a local file or a YouTube link (downloaded once with yt-dlp, never streamed). The video loops silently and pauses whenever a window covers the desktop, costing the same GPU as a static wallpaper. Switch themes and come back: its video, or the image you chose, returns. The lock screen and bg switcher keep working.
